title: Scene
description: A semantic scene segment extracted from a long-form video, consisting of one or more merged shots.

scene_id.description: Unique identifier for the scene, e.g. 'sc_014'

start_ts.description: Scene start timestamp in seconds from the start of the video

end_ts.description: Scene end timestamp in seconds; must be strictly greater than start_ts

shot_ids.description: Ordered list of shot IDs that were merged to form this scene

activity_tags.description: Zero-shot activity/context labels detected in this scene, sorted by descending confidence

label.description: Human-readable activity or context label, e.g. 'funeral', 'celebration'

confidence.description: Model confidence score for this label

dominant_activity.description: The single highest-confidence activity tag label; drives brand-matching weighting

asr_text.description: Full ASR transcript of dialogue/narration within this scene (may be empty string if silent)

embedding.description: Optional dense vector representation of the scene (model-versioned). Dimension is 384 or 768 depending on the encoder declared in model_versions.yaml.
